title: Stahlta
extract:
The Stahlta is a  Corpus automatic rifle that shoots steel blade projectiles. Alternate Fire charges a powerful  Radiation explosive.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage on its primary fire, and  Radiation on its Alternate Fire.
Alternate Fire charges a powerful round that explodes.
Direct hits have a guaranteed  Impact proc.
Shots explode in a 7.2 meter radius 0.36 seconds after impacting a surface or enemy.
Explosion delay reduces likelihood of inflicting self-stagger, but may allow enemies to move out of the explosion range if not directly hit by the projectile.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Explosion can benefit from  Firestorm ( Primed) and  Cautious Shot.
Charge is automatic and does not need to be held down.
Charged shots do not arc, allowing for accurate placement of explosions at extreme range.
Consumes 20 ammo per shot.
Has a limited range of 400m, at which point the projectile will dissipate without exploding.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Primary fire has an innate 1.2 meter punch through.
Alternate Fire:
Tied with  Quellor and  Tenora Prime for the highest critical chance of all charge-up rifles.
Tied with  Battacor and  Tenora/ Tenora Prime for the highest critical multiplier of all charge-up rifles.

Acquisition
The Stahlta's main blueprint is a possible reward from defeating the Jackal. Components are acquired from within the Granum Void: the Receiver from Rotation C of the Normal Granum Void, the Stock from Rotation C of the Exemplar Granum Void, and the Barrel from Rotation C of the Zenith Granum Void. All components can be traded between players, but not the main blueprint.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Known Bugs
 Galvanized Aptitude is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits in both firing modes.
Despite what the in-game UI says, the Alt-Fire AoE status chance is 50%.

Trivia
The Stahlta's design resembles a Forward Defense Munitions L5 Caseless Ammo Rifle.
The weapon's name is derived from Stahl, the German word for "steel".
Like many Corpus weapons, the "magazine" appears to actually be a power source, perhaps atomic from the radioactive properties, as the steel blades it fires are twice as large as the magazine.
Starting December 10th, 2020, this weapon, along with the  Drakgoon and  Ogris, had a themed skin which could be obtained for free from the Epic Games Unreal Tournament Weapon Bundle, formerly available on the Epic Games Launcher.
On December 9th, 2024, the skins were made available upon login until December 23rd, 2024, after which the skins were permanently added to the Market for  1.
